title: Field permissions
loadingFailed: Unable to load the policy. Check your management permission and reload.
reloadRequired: The policy or permissions may have changed. Reload before continuing. Do not repeat the previous request.
candidate: Candidate policies do not affect user data yet.
blocked: Activation checks have not passed. Field policies cannot be enabled yet.
FIELD_POLICY_ACTIVE_ADAPTERS_REQUIRED: Some business entry points cannot load active policies yet
FIELD_POLICY_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED: Full entry point and client acceptance is incomplete
previewHint: Rule differences and effective samples for current role members; no business field values.
activeHint: Policy is active. Publishing changes updates permissions immediately and invalidates previous transfers and AI results.
sampleHint: Computed from current memberships and record scopes, up to 5 members × 20 records. Samples do not prove full query coverage.
subject: Actor ID
FIELD_POLICY_DEPLOYMENT_DISABLED: Field policies are disabled in this deployment
FIELD_POLICY_QUALIFICATION_REQUIRED: This build needs valid entrypoint and client qualification
FIELD_POLICY_READY_REQUIRED: Publish a policy and mark it ready first
relationUnavailable: Relations are incomplete or replacement is not permitted. Reload or contact an administrator.
readingHint: Read controls returned values; query controls filtering and statistics. Masked reads do not grant sensitive queries.
writingHint: Configure create, update and relation replacement separately. Self-service and management purposes are distinct.
transferHint: Import create, update and matching have separate grants. Export is independent of read.
bulkScope: Scope: {object} · {tab} · all loaded fields, independent of search.
bulkSummary: {object} · {tab}: change {changed}, skip {skipped}, mask {masked}. Updates the draft only; saving a candidate does not activate it.
abstractPreview: Permission differences only; no business values are read or displayed. Preview expires after 5 minutes or a source change.
unknownHint: Commit outcome is unknown. Keep the request ID and check its receipt. Do not resubmit; no receipt still means unknown.
candidateSaved: Candidate saved. Active policy is unchanged.
tenantManifestHint: Seal all {count} role/object revision references in this tenant, including other roles and dependencies. No automatic activation.
freezeClosureHint: Freeze this object and its server-computed dependency closure. Affected business entry points are blocked; active policy and history remain.
FULL_SYSTEM_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED: Full-system entry point and client acceptance is incomplete. Candidates can be prepared; activation and normal admission remain blocked.
readOnly: This identity has read-only management access.
menuRelationship: Menus and buttons control actions, data scope controls records, and field policies control fields by purpose. All three must permit an operation.
prepareHint: Normal API, scheduler and background business jobs remain stopped. This page manages candidates only.
prepareFinishHint: The preparation listener stops. Normal services and database admission remain closed.
loginFailed: Sign-in failed. Check credentials, current management authority and preparation session status.
sessionExpired: Preparation session expired. Sign in again.
prepareUnavailable: Preparation service unavailable. Check controlled installation records.
prepareEnded: Preparation session ended; normal services remain stopped.
